Definition: Tsuph or Tsophai or Tsiph, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Zuph is an Israelite of Ephraim, the ancestor of Elkanah and of Samuel. In 1 Samuel 1:1, the son of Zuph. The fuller story is told on the Zuph profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Zuph shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
